card.name: Hospital admission and inpatient care
card.fires_on: Words in hospital-stay phrases, such as admission, hospitalized, the word hospital inside hospitalization, and 'in' before 'a hospital setting'. It also fires partway through words like antibacterial and sedation in care-setting text.

modes.label: Hospital stay words
modes.description: Admission, hospitalization or inpatient wording describing being in a hospital or ICU.
modes.example: underlying medical conditions affecting thyroid function,<< admission>> to neonatal or pediatric intensive care units

modes.label: Partway through long clinical words
modes.description: Middle of words such as antibacterial, sedation or vecuronium in hospital-type drug text.
modes.example: ongoing antib<<acterial>> drug use not directed against C. difficile

card.writes: It pushes toward hospital and hospitalized-patient words, including Chinese terms for hospital beds and admission.
card.plain: It lights up when text is about patients being admitted to or staying in hospital.
